exec git init -b main
env TZ=UTC
at 2026-07-16T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix order-
exec card config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential

exec card create --priority 4 'First issue'
exec card create 'Second issue'
exec card create 'Third issue'
exec card create 'Fourth issue'
exec card create 'Fifth issue'
exec card create 'Sixth issue'
exec card create 'Seventh issue'
exec card create 'Eighth issue'
exec card create 'Ninth issue'

at 2026-07-16T12:01:00Z
exec card create --priority 0 'Tenth issue'

# Unspecified list order follows creation rather than priority or lexical ID.
exec card --json list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/created.jsonl

# Priority-driven callers can still request priority ordering explicitly.
exec card --json list --sort priority
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/priority.jsonl

# Issue identity is not a public presentation sort.
! exec card list --sort id
! stdout .
stderr 'unsupported sort field "id"'
